entities.name: Ramón Javier Mestre
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ramón Javier Mestre, is an Argentine lawyer and politician for the Unión Cívica Radical. In the elections of September 2011, he was elected mayor of the city of Córdoba. He would hold this role until 2019.
